key_insight: Constraint-aware reinforcement learning reduces battery sizing requirements for PV ramp-rate smoothing while maintaining grid-code compliance.
engineering_relevance: Jointly designing battery storage and its controller can reduce required power and energy capacity without relying on PV forecasts during deployment.
method: Learn a causal state-feedback control policy from historical PV data.
Restrict actions using a feasibility interval incorporating ramp-rate, converter-power, and state-of-charge constraints.
Compare performance with a full-horizon, noncausal input-convex neural network optimization benchmark.
evidence_signal: Across three real-world PV datasets at a 10%/min ramp-rate limit, CARL reduced peak battery power by 8.7–10.4% and energy capacity by 47.5–62.6% versus conventional ramp-rate control while maintaining compliance.
watch_item: Performance under unseen PV conditions and real-world deployment remains to be established beyond the reported dataset evaluations.
paper_title: Battery Energy Storage Sizing in PV Ramp-Rate Smoothing using Constraint-Aware Reinforcement Learning-Based Controller
